google.guideTitle: How to get a Client ID (one time, about 5 minutes)
google.guide:
1. Go to console.cloud.google.com and create a new Project (any name).
2. APIs & Services → Library → enable "Google Calendar API".
3. APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen: choose External, fill in an app name and your email. Then press Publish app (otherwise access lasts only 7 days; it is only for you so no Google review is needed).
4. Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → type "Desktop app" → Create.
5. Paste the Client ID and Client secret above, press Connect, sign in to Google and press Allow. If you see "Google hasn't verified this app": Advanced → Go to ... (it is your own app).
6. On your phone open Google Calendar with the same account and tick the "Lịch học" calendar.
